section_summary: Most of this section consists of June 1941 telegrams tracking Japanese merchant vessels, often followed by paraphrases sent to the Navy. The reports record routes, port calls, bills of health, cargo, and a Navy-chartered tanker. The final pages concern the customs search of the Nisshin Maru at San Francisco and the temporary removal of its documents.

subfiles.title: Norway Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Norway Maru's arrival from Guayaquil and departure toward Valparaíso.
subfiles.summary: Norway Maru reached Callao June 11 and left June 13 via Arica.

subfiles.title: Identification of Tyoko Maru
subfiles.about: Corrects the spelling used for a ship's name.
subfiles.summary: Identifies the Tyoko Maru as the vessel previously spelled Chokoh Maru.

subfiles.title: Identification of Tyoko Maru: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Forwards the correction to the ship's name.
subfiles.summary: Repeats Dickover's identification of Tyoko Maru, previously Chokoh Maru.

subfiles.title: Hague Maru departure
subfiles.about: Reports the Hague Maru sailing for Calcutta.
subfiles.summary: Hague Maru reportedly sailed June 9.

subfiles.title: Hague Maru departure: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Hague Maru's reported departure.
subfiles.summary: Reports a June 9 sailing for Calcutta.

subfiles.title: Tosan, Gyoko and Kyusyu sailings
subfiles.about: Reports June 10 sailings by three Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Gives routes for Tosan to New York, Gyoko to San Francisco, and Kyusyu to Manila and Cebu.

subfiles.title: Tosan, Gyoko and Kyusyu sailings: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the three vessels' June 10 departures.
subfiles.summary: Restates their routes through Los Angeles and Cristóbal or toward the Philippines.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru at Callao
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; for Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports the Ginyo Maru's Callao port call.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 13 from Moji via Buenaventura; sailed June 14 toward Valparaíso via Mollendo.

subfiles.title: Ondo Maru departure
subfiles.about: Reports the Ondo Maru's June 7 departure.
subfiles.summary: Ondo Maru sailed via Miike for Hong Kong, Manila and Davao.

subfiles.title: Ondo Maru departure: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Ondo Maru's route.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the June 7 sailing via Miike.

subfiles.title: Tenyo departure
subfiles.about: Reports Tenyo sailing for Legazpi.
subfiles.summary: Tenyo sailed June 12 for the Philippines.

subfiles.title: Tenyo departure: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Tenyo's departure.
subfiles.summary: Tenyo Maru cleared Yokohama for Legazpi.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports Takaoka Maru's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 13 from Iquique; sailed June 15 toward Yokohama via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru at Valparaíso: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Takaoka Maru's Valparaíso port call.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the arrival from Iquique and sailing for Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru at Callao
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; for Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports Sagami Maru's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 14 from Yokohama via Buenaventura; sailed June 15 via Mollendo for Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru at Callao: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Forwards the Sagami Maru movement report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats McGurk's Callao arrival and departure report.

subfiles.title: Nana Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Nana Maru's Santos port call.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 15 from Rio de Janeiro and sailed June 16 for Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Nana Maru at Santos: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Nana Maru's Santos port call.
subfiles.summary: Repeats arrival from Rio de Janeiro and sailing for Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Myoken, Kamakura and Akagi departures
subfiles.about: Reports three ship departures, with Myoken's destination omitted.
subfiles.summary: Kamakura and Akagi sailed for San Francisco; Akagi would continue to South American west coast ports.

subfiles.title: Myoken, Kamakura and Akagi: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the departures while leaving Myoken's destination unspecified.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the San Francisco routes and notes that Myoken sailed.

subfiles.title: Corrected Myoken, Kamakura and Akagi report
subfiles.about: Supplies Myoken's omitted destination.
subfiles.summary: Myoken sailed for Shanghai; Kamakura for San Francisco; Akagi for San Francisco and South American ports.

subfiles.title: Corrected ship departures: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the corrected destinations of Myoken, Kamakura and Akagi.
subfiles.summary: Adds Shanghai as Myoken's destination.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Seia Maru's arrival and route toward Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 15 from Buenos Aires; sailed June 18 via Rio de Janeiro, La Guaira and Panama.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at Santos: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Seia Maru's route through South America and Panama.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the June 18 departure for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Nana Maru at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports Nana Maru's arrival and planned itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Arrived from Brazil and planned to depart the same day through South American ports, the Canal Zone and Los Angeles to Kobe.

subfiles.title: Nana Maru at Montevideo: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Nana Maru's planned route to Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Lists calls in Argentina, Brazil, Venezuela, the Canal Zone and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Bills of health for four vessels
subfiles.about: Lists bills of health granted to Japanese vessels since June 9.
subfiles.summary: Names Kamakura, Nozima, Cuba and Kunikawa, with their destinations or routes.

subfiles.title: Bills of health for four vessels: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the four bills of health.
subfiles.summary: Repeats routes for Kunikawa, Kamakura, Cuba and Nozima.

subfiles.title: Pictures and speeds of Japanese merchant ships
subfiles.about: Describes enclosed ship photographs and claims Japanese vessels can exceed their registered speeds.
subfiles.summary: Notes a possible misidentified ship photograph and asks whether more photographs are needed.

subfiles.title: Kamakura departure date
subfiles.about: Answers an inquiry about Kamakura's departure.
subfiles.summary: States that Kamakura sailed from Yokohama June 14.

subfiles.title: Kamakura departure date: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Kamakura's departure date.
subfiles.summary: Kamakura left Yokohama June 14.

subfiles.title: Asuka Maru at La Guaira
subfiles.about: Reports Asuka Maru's arrival and onward route.
subfiles.summary: Arrived from Curaçao June 20; planned to sail for Ciudad Trujillo, Havana and New Orleans.

subfiles.title: Asuka Maru at La Guaira: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Asuka Maru's La Guaira port call.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the arrival from Curaçao and planned departure.

subfiles.title: Yamahagi and Sydney departures
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese vessel departures in the Pacific.
subfiles.summary: Yamahagi left Goro for Wallaroo June 18; Sydney left Sydney for Yokohama June 19.

subfiles.title: Yamazuki Maru at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports Yamazuki Maru's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 8; departed June 20 for Kobe via Santos, Panama Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Yamazuki Maru at Buenos Aires: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Yamazuki Maru's departure route.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its June 8 arrival and June 20 sailing.

subfiles.title: Seiwa at Makatea
subfiles.about: Reports Seiwa's Makatea port call.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 16 from Japan and sailed June 19 for Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Seiwa at Makatea: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Forwards the Seiwa movement report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats Mersman's Makatea report.

subfiles.title: Inquiry about Kamakura
subfiles.about: Asks whether Kamakura departed Yokohama June 12.
subfiles.summary: Says no report had been received; sent at Commander Frothingham's request.

subfiles.title: Malta Maru departure
subfiles.about: Reports Malta Maru clearing for Singapore.
subfiles.summary: Reported departure occurred June 20.

subfiles.title: Malta Maru departure: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Malta Maru's reported departure.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its June 20 sailing for Singapore.

subfiles.title: Aobasan and Kitano departures
subfiles.about: Reports destinations of Aobasan and Kitano.
subfiles.summary: Aobasan left for Madras and Bombay; Kitano for Batavia.

subfiles.title: Aobasan and Kitano departures: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the two departures.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Indian and Batavia destinations.

subfiles.title: Correction to Asuka Maru voucher
subfiles.from: Mary Tallant, Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.about: Corrects a vessel name on a voucher for Lawton's telegram.
subfiles.summary: The telegram concerns Asuka, not Azura.

subfiles.title: Asuka at Ciudad Trujillo
subfiles.about: Reports Asuka's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 22 from La Guaira and departed the same day via Havana for New Orleans.

subfiles.title: Asuka at Ciudad Trujillo: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Asuka's Ciudad Trujillo port call.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the June 22 arrival and departure.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports Takaoka Maru's Antofagasta port call.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 20 from Chañaral; scheduled to sail June 23 for Iquique.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru at Antofagasta: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Takaoka Maru's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its Chañaral to Iquique movement.

subfiles.title: Maruto Maru at Buenaventura
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; for Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports Maruto Maru's Buenaventura port call.
subfiles.summary: Arrived from Japan via San Francisco and left June 22 for Peru and Chile.

subfiles.title: Maruto Maru at Buenaventura: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Maruto Maru's movement.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival via San Francisco and departure for Peru and Chile.

subfiles.title: Five Yokohama vessel departures
subfiles.about: Reports routes of five vessels said to have sailed June 19.
subfiles.summary: Lists Cuba, Kunikawa, Asama, Erie and Melbourne Maru; a later telegram corrects Cuba Maru's departure date.

subfiles.title: Five Yokohama vessel departures: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the five reported departures.
subfiles.summary: Lists routes to Seattle, South America, Manila, Batavia and Bombay.

subfiles.title: Four sailings reported from Nagasaki
subfiles.about: Reports four vessel sailings with uncertain names in the received text.
subfiles.summary: Lists Denmark, Hofuku, an unclear Maru and Tonan; repetition of the entire message was requested.

subfiles.title: Corrected Nagasaki sailing report
subfiles.about: Corrects the Nagasaki report's vessel names and routes.
subfiles.summary: Names Denmark and Hofuku for the Philippines, Nanman for South America, and whaler Tonan for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Corrected Nagasaki sailings: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the corrected four-vessel report.
subfiles.summary: Gives sailing dates, destinations and net tonnages for Nanman, Tonan, Denmark and Hofuku.

subfiles.title: Onoe at Thursday Island
subfiles.about: Reports Onoe's arrival from Davao.
subfiles.summary: Onoe arrived at Thursday Island June 23.

subfiles.title: Onoe at Thursday Island: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Forwards the Onoe arrival report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats Dickover's June 23 report.

subfiles.title: Norway, Sagami and Ginyo Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and departures of three Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Norway arrived June 20; Sagami and Ginyo arrived June 21 from Arica. Ginyo left June 23, while Sagami and Norway were to sail June 24 for Kobe via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Valparaíso vessel movements: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the three vessels' Valparaíso movements.
subfiles.summary: Reports arrivals and the departures of Ginyo, Sagami and Norway.

subfiles.title: Valparaíso movements: clarified Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Clarifies ambiguities in the Valparaíso telegram.
subfiles.summary: Notes uncertainty about Norway's previous port and Ginyo's onward route.

subfiles.title: Five departures and Cuba Maru correction
subfiles.about: Reports June 21–22 sailings and corrects Cuba Maru's date.
subfiles.summary: Tatsuta, Yawata and Takekawa sailed June 21; Yamabiko and Cuba sailed June 22. Cuba had not left June 19 as earlier reported.

subfiles.title: Five departures and Cuba correction: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the sailings and corrected Cuba Maru date.
subfiles.summary: Lists destinations for Cuba, Yamabiko, Takekawa, Yawata and Tatsuta.

subfiles.title: Yamazuki Maru cargo inquiry cross-reference
subfiles.about: Points to an inquiry into Yamazuki Maru cargo's possible German destination.
subfiles.summary: References telegram 362 asking whether cargo was destined for Germany.

subfiles.title: Yamazuki Maru Brazilian cargo cross-reference
subfiles.about: Points to instructions concerning cargo possibly bound for Germany.
subfiles.summary: References telegram 702 about Brazilian cargo and possible transshipment.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa Maru cargo at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports Kiyokawa Maru's cargo, passenger and planned loading.
subfiles.summary: Arrived from Los Angeles with artificial silk and general cargo. One passenger disembarked for Mexico City; lead, mercury and other metals might be loaded before departure for Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa Maru cargo: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Kiyokawa Maru's cargo and planned departure.
subfiles.summary: Lists cargo quantities, possible metal loading and a June 28 sailing for Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Kokuyo Maru Navy charter
subfiles.about: Reports the Navy-chartered Kokuyo Maru's planned fuel-loading voyage.
subfiles.summary: The tanker was to leave Kure June 25 directly for Los Angeles; it had been placed on a British blacklist there.

subfiles.title: Kokuyo Maru Navy charter: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Kokuyo Maru's charter, route and blacklist status.
subfiles.summary: States that the tanker would load gasoline and oil at Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Kyokuyo tanker departure
subfiles.about: Reports Kyokuyo's sailing for Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The tanker left June 23.

subfiles.title: Kyokuyo departure: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Kyokuyo's departure for California.
subfiles.summary: The surviving OCR is fragmentary but corresponds to the June 23 tanker departure.

subfiles.title: Bills of health for Asama, Buenos Aires and Nippon
subfiles.about: Lists three bills of health granted since June 21.
subfiles.summary: Asama was bound for Manila, Buenos Aires for the Canal Zone, and Nippon for San Francisco to load fuel.

subfiles.title: Three bills of health: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays bills of health for three Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: OCR is damaged; the preceding telegram supplies the vessels and routes.

subfiles.title: Bills of health for Yawata, Yamabiko and Akagi
subfiles.about: Lists bills of health granted since June 16.
subfiles.summary: Gives routes to Los Angeles, Seattle and the Canal Zone.

subfiles.title: Three further bills of health: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays bills of health for Akagi, Yamabiko and Yawata.
subfiles.summary: Repeats their routes through San Francisco, Manzanillo or Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Nana Maru at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports Nana Maru's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Arrived June 20; sailed June 26 toward Los Angeles and Yokohama via Brazilian and Venezuelan ports and Panama.

subfiles.title: Nana Maru at Buenos Aires: Navy paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Nana Maru's onward itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its June 20 arrival and June 26 departure.

subfiles.title: Treasury response on search of Nisshin Maru
subfiles.from: Herbert E. Gaston, Assistant Secretary of the Treasury
subfiles.about: Answers the Japanese Embassy's protest concerning a customs search and temporary seizure of ship documents.
subfiles.summary: Treasury records describe a routine search, seizure of heroin and a bag of Japanese-language papers, and the consulate's protest that the papers included codes and ship documents. Officers were ordered to return the bag on May 28; travel and receipt delays postponed its return until about 8:30 p.m.

subfiles.title: Customs account of Nisshin Maru search
subfiles.about: Recounts customs records concerning the Nisshin Maru search and Japanese Embassy aide-mémoire.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum restates the ship's arrival, routine search, seizure of heroin and Japanese-language papers, consular protest, and order to return the papers. Its text continues beyond page 480.
